scope: Accepted foundation evaluation tooling; F04/F05 qualification remains incomplete

review.author: neophilism
review.body:
## Separate assistant self security review

Reviewed final head `dbc55adbcecfdb83d0e53c7c2a1e0b3e6510f863`, tree `3d810a00fac0ce671cce6fc5551f1bc6282743e8`, against base `64c3dbfc8818c4ebaac64f94103f26815e539c96`. This is assistant self review, including a separate read-only agent examination; it is not independent human approval.

No unresolved blocking source finding identified in this evaluation-integration scope.

### Boundaries reviewed
- Minimal CI permissions, pinned actions, credential-filtered subprocesses, explicit empty npm configuration for isolated evaluation audits, and required aggregate behavior on failed/skipped/cancelled work or failed artifact upload.
- Fresh browser command/run/time binding, exact source/build/fixture/lock fingerprints, contained and bounded artifact files, malformed audit rejection, and current head/base/tree/run/workflow identity. Historical artifacts cannot establish current-candidate acceptance.
- Bounded untrusted GLB/glTF parsing and allocation, rejection of external resource routes, serialized imports, failed-import rollback before publication, object-URL ownership and disposal.
- One audible WebAudio route per source, attached video/bird emitters, analysis-only paired meters with bounded messages/history, actual post-disposal input/resource checks, and no provider credentials in this integration.
- The repaired movement observation uses real DOM focus/keydown/keyup and the running physics counter, preserves the >0.1m assertion, bounds waiting at 10 seconds and releases the key in `finally`. Its 21-step measurement is functional input evidence, not a latency/performance qualification. The previous failure's exact cause is not asserted.
- Synthetic verifier-fixture fingerprint rebinding is in-memory test data only. It writes no historical report and is not a runtime evidence path. Existing tamper/stale-source rejection tests remain passing.

### Actual verification and remaining gates
Fresh local checks passed 39 package tests, 136 tooling tests, nine F04 toolkit tests, the 68-file retained-artifact integrity check, 30 F05 tests and all 19 actual Chromium browser checks. The current local browser run was `run-Uwnp8O` (2026-10-18T17:02:13.825Z–17:02:27.674Z), report SHA-256 `260bed97f375dbf1fa11a7e58fe7de57d17130ef78d6eee4add591ef1c029d4d`; it retains honest local/incomplete status. Fresh root/F04/F05 audits reported zero advisories.

The first hosted run `39147325398` failed 1/19 browser checks and correctly blocked acceptance; its unchanged downloaded artifacts are retained in the repository. Final-head hosted run `39147840501`, both downloaded-artifact verifications, fresh mergeability/head/base/review checks and applicable main verification remain required before accepting integration. Full F04/F05 service, hardware and shared-world qualification remains incomplete regardless of this PR's outcome.
